column3: “Queen mother” identifies the lady, and “court officials” renders eunuchs.
“The letter was entrusted” supplies a verb for “by the hand.”
The exiling is passive instead of “I exiled.”
“From them” supplies those caused to dream.
“Restore you from captivity” renders turning back your captivity.
“Again and again” renders rising early and sending; “exiles” identifies the final “you.”
“You said to Zephaniah” identifies the addressee of the following statement.
“Chief officer” renders plural overseers; “acts like a prophet” specifies prophesying.
“Poses as a prophet” specifies the reflexive prophetic verb.
